searchText: <@&595685821026271242> is the amount of emitted eth somewhat constant no matter how much eth is staked? No. is it close to constant, i think i played with the tool on ultrasound money and its around 900k-1m ETH/year I'm not sure how you got that. Issuance can range between 180k/year to 1.4M/year depending on how many stakers there are. This is before base fee burning, so the actual issuance rate will be less than that (potentially negative). noted, thanks! this is what i wanted to know
